pattern: Pina promises to bring a result back without recording a report
experience: A user asked Pina to have an investigation thread in another project file an issue and send back its link. Pina relayed it, promised the link, and never reported it (zjywill/PinaCode#11).
prompt: Ask the memory directory investigation thread in acme/app to file its plan as a GitHub issue, and bring me back the issue link when it's done.

prompt: Create a new conversation in project project-app to check which of its open issues are resolved. Tell me when it finishes.
